# Flashcards World

> > Flashcards World is a free flashcard maker featuring spaced repetition for effective learning across iOS, Android, and web platforms.

Flashcards World provides a cross-platform educational tool for creating and studying flashcards using scientifically-proven spaced repetition techniques. The platform offers an alternative to Anki with a user-friendly interface for students and lifelong learners.

- Study App

- Android App
- Memory Retention
